title: Ro$$ Mac Discusses "A Dub" Landing on NBA 2K21
htmlContent:
We can always count on NBA 2k to put together a killer soundtrack each year and 2K21 is no different. This year's 50 single Tracklist includes hits such as "Kobe" featuring Dame Dolla, Snoop Dogg, and Derrick Milano, The Weeknd's smash hit "Blinding Lights, "and the late Juice WRLD's "Let Me Know" to name a few.

Another single on the soundtrack is "A Dub" by Ro$$ Mac off his album "Maconomics 101."

"So, I was lucky enough to get a song called "A Dub" on NBA 2K21 and it's lit. The song is a vibe just a pure energetic of just saying you need money. I think everybody can relate to that," Mac shared on the Catch the Wave Podcast. "I was lucky enough to distribute it through United Masters, and I was able to get the song on 2k. So, it's Lit."

Mac is an artist from Chicago, Illinois with an Ivy league background as he graduated with a degree from the Wharton School of Business at University of Pennsylvania. His music content focuses on teaching its listeners about investing and generating generational wealth. On his 'Maconomics" show on REVOLT TV focused on giving investment tips, and teaches financial literacy organization.
